message:
So `GenericHash::cleanup` deletes all entries in the hash table, which calls `Flow::~Flow`. The flow needs to be in the hash table when cleanup is called.

Now let me understand when a flow gets added to the hash table. Let me check `NetworkInterface::dissectPacket`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/ntopng && grep -n "dissectPacket" src/NetworkInterface.cpp | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜invoke>
